name: Qatar
description: Qatar from its pearl divers and the Al Thani to British protection, independence, natural gas, Al Jazeera and the 2022 World Cup.

checkpoints.name: Pearl coast
checkpoints.note: Zubarah was a busy pearling town. The Al Thani family rose in Doha.

checkpoints.name: Protectorate
checkpoints.note: Britain recognised the Al Thani in 1868 and later made Qatar a protectorate. Oil was found in 1939.

checkpoints.name: Independent Qatar
checkpoints.note: Qatar became independent in 1971. Gas made it rich, Al Jazeera made it known, and it hosted the World Cup in 2022.
